edits.english: GEMARA: Rabbi Elazar says that Rabbi Oshaya says: Just as ben Beteira disqualifies a Paschal offering that one slaughtered on the morning of the fourteenth of Nisan not for its sake, so too, ben Beteira would deem fit a Paschal offering that one slaughtered on the morning of the fourteenth of Nisan for its sake, as he held that the entire day, the fourteenth of Nisan, is its designated time.

edits.hebrew: מכשיר היה בן בתירא בפסח ששחטו שחרית לשמו - דפסח בשאר ימות השנה חשיב ליה.:אבדעקמוןרו

edits.english: Ben Beteira would deem fit a Paschal offering that one slaughtered on the morning [of Passover eve] for its sake - for he considers it a Paschal offering from the rest of the days of the year.

edits.hebrew: בן בתירא פוסל - בגמרא מפרש להו.:אבדעקמוןרו

edits.english: Ben Beteira deems it unfit - The Gemara explains his reasoning.
